Explore DoaneX: Flexible Online Learning for Career Advancement

DoaneX, Doane University's partnership with edX, offers a range of online programs designed to fit your educational and professional goals. Whether you're looking to gain new skills, earn college credit or pursue a graduate degree, DoaneX provides accessible and affordable options.

Explore all available programs and start your learning journey with DoaneX today.
 

DoaneX Courses and Programs

DoaneX Program and Certificate Options

Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) provide free, web-based classes that anyone can access, covering a
wide range of topics. These courses are typically non-credit-bearing and let students set their own pace. While
the courses themselves are free, you can choose to pay for a certificate if you want proof of completion.
MOOCs are perfect for those who want to learn about new subjects or deepen their understanding of current
ones, all without any long-term commitment.

Undergraduate-level courses completed as a part of a Microbachelors program are affordably priced and cater to individuals who wish to begin a bachelor's degree. If you're looking to acquire practical, job-ready skills and start your undergraduate degree, a Microbachelor's might be the right fit for you.  Undergraduate-level course credit is awarded through Thomas Edison State University, upon completion of a Microbachelors.

Professional certificates consist of brief courses aimed at honing specific career skills. Created in partnership
with leading industry figures, these credentials maintain their relevance and best serve individuals seeking to
upgrade or switch skills in their chosen career path.

MicroMasters® Programs offer graduate-level courses that can speed up your pathway to a master's degree at
Doane University. By completing these programs, students gain a credential that employers value, and it can
count towards a full master's degree. MicroMasters® Programs are perfect for individuals aiming to boost their
careers or start graduate-level education.

Apply Your Learning Towards a Doane Master’s Degree

A variety of Doane X programs and Micromasters can be applied toward the Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Master of Arts in Leadership (MIL) degrees offered by Doane University. These stackable credentials enable you to:

  • Accelerate Your Degree: Use completed MicroMasters® or MicroBachelors® programs to fulfill prerequisites or earn credit.
  • Flexible Learning: Choose between online or in-person classes to fit your schedule.
  • Cost-Effective Pathways: Reduce overall tuition costs by earning credits through DoaneX programs

Explore DoaneX
